name: cobesy
description: Turn knowledge into adoption plans, briefings, and structured writing with COBESY's culture, cognitive, and network lenses. Use for rollouts, buy-in, resistance, onboarding, or organizing a blog post, thesis, article, or slides before drafting. Produces framing, content structure, and an adoption path. Skip factual lookup and single-fact questions.
